_comment: Example ngen-cal configuration for Snow17 3-parameter ADC calibration
_note: This example shows 3-parameter ADC calibration. For 11-point calibration, use adc2-adc10 instead.

_calibration_modes.3param_adc: Use adc_a, adc_b, adc_c parameters (as shown below)
_calibration_modes.11point_adc: Use adc2, adc3, ..., adc10 parameters (adc1=0.05, adc11=1.0 typically fixed)
_calibration_modes.hybrid: Provide some parameters in config file, calibrate subset via BMI
_calibration_modes.partial: Calibrate only specific parameters, others use defaults or file values
